analysis_set.span: The full analysis set (FAS) was defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication and 1 dose of oral antidepressant medication during the double-blind induction phase.

treatment_strategy.span: ARM: Placebo plus Oral Antidepressant [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Participants will self-administer matching placebo, intranasally, twice per week for 4 weeks as a flexible dose regimen in Double-Blind Induction Phase using the same titration as Esketamine.

follow_up.span: TIME FRAME: Baseline up to Endpoint (Double-blind Induction Phase[Day 28]) | POPULATION: The full analysis set (FAS)

absent_reason.ci: The held registry reports confidence intervals for adjusted MMRM and ANCOVA least-squares contrasts, but none for the served observed-case raw change-score mean difference. No full text is held.

candidate_rejections.span: Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -3.6 (95% CI -7.20 to 0.07) | p =0.059 | METHOD Mixed Model for Repeated Measures
candidate_rejections.why: This adjusted MMRM contrast and confidence interval cannot be bound to the served observed-case raw mean difference.

candidate_rejections.span: Least Square (LS) Mean Difference -3.6 (95% CI -7.16 to -0.03) | p =0.052 | METHOD ANCOVA
candidate_rejections.why: This adjusted ANCOVA contrast uses the separately reported LOCF endpoint and cannot supply the confidence interval for the served observed-case raw mean difference.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled elderly adults with treatment-resistant depression, within the question's adult population; the registry defines the outcome analysis population as FAS.
entry_population_matches_question.span: A Randomized, Double-blind, Multicenter, Active-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Intranasal Esketamine Plus an Oral Antidepressant in Elderly Subjects With Treatment-resistant Depression

notes: Registry spans are used. The served arm means, SDs and denominators match outcome 0; the registry explicitly labels its dispersion as Standard Deviation. The endpoint heading names MMRM, while the bound numbers are its descriptive arm summaries. No raw between-arm estimate or confidence interval was calculated. The treatment span identifies the comparator regimen; separate registry passages describe esketamine 28, 56 or 84 mg and a newly initiated oral antidepressant in both arms. Set-aside concerns the missing matching confidence interval, not trial eligibility.
